save_model: save a PyTorch model state dict, optimizer, stats, and config to disk as .pth and .pkl files
load_model: load a PyTorch model state dict, stats, and optimizer from .pth and .pkl checkpoint files
find_last_checkpoint: find the most recent model checkpoint file in an experiment directory by epoch number
purge_epoch: delete all checkpoint files for a specific epoch including model, optimizer, and stats files
download_model: download a pretrained model from a URL, verify its MD5 checksum, and save the config
